proposal.observation: Round 1 improved correspondence_f1@15 from 0.3370 to 0.3458 while preserving all 10 rings and the depth hole ratio; SAM fill changed only slightly from 0.7349 to 0.7330. The after images add useful oblique detections and prompt evidence, but oblique coverage remains sparse across several vertical ring bands.
proposal.rule: Continue ontology rule d7 and remediation r_relax_hough: when accepted relaxation increases useful oblique detections without changing ring count or depth holes, make one small bounded relaxation of the oblique accumulator threshold while retaining the accepted line-gap setting.
proposal.rationale: The accepted round-1 response provides case-specific evidence that relaxing oblique detection helps correspondence with negligible coverage cost. Lowering only hough_threshold_oblique from 44 to its bound of 40 is a conservative continuation on the new incumbent; maxLineGap_oblique remains at the accepted value 47, unfolding remains untouched, and no joint-example parameter is given individual causal credit.
